sentences.en: Joan and Jane are sisters. The former is a pianist.
sentences.zh: 琼和简是姐妹。前者是一位钢琴家。

sentences.en: The former is inferior to the latter in some respect.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，前者不如后者。

sentences.en: Many support the former alternative, but I prefer the latter.
sentences.zh: 很多人支持前者的选择，但我更喜欢后者。
